reason: I don't sign a 12-month contract with a new company that has no customer results, and nobody at 7-Eleven or Alfamart is using this that I know of. That's almost a million pesos a year for 10 stores. I already rearrange displays myself every weekend for free.
objection: Our CCTV is old and low resolution. I don't believe it can track shoppers well enough to make a simulation I would trust, and I have no proof it works in a store like mine.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a big chain like 7-Eleven or Alfamart get real results with it, or a free pilot on 2-3 of my stores using our old cameras with no 12-month lock-in.
